study_type: offline deterministic reducer qualification; preregistered future execution
question: Does one frozen pure reducer implement the tested frozen v2 ledger contract without an oracle dependency?
decision: Strict fresh control/pair correctness plus source/runtime independence; no average safety substitution.

fresh_controls.author: fresh_acceptance_v2
fresh_controls.author_aperture: fork_turns=none; actively read only frozen policy/interface/minimal schema copies; inventoried generic startup context
fresh_controls.expectations: agent_llm authored hypotheses; needs-audit, no semantic assessor evidence

known_regression_controls.result_role: optional separately reported legacy compatibility; original keys remain v1

post_freeze_reveal: known regression controls only after candidate freeze
primary_metric: every fresh control and every pair exact; source/oracle review must be clear
unit_of_analysis: individual assessment ledger -> decision record, with supplementary endpoint relations
acceptance_rule: Valid complete execution, every fresh expected required field exact except reason text, all 33 relations with two exact endpoints, canonical output schema, no v2 safety failure on any observed input, and no prohibited oracle dependency.
falsification_rule: Any valid contractual mismatch/failed relation/unsafe authorization or detected implementation shortcut; no average override. Legacy version disagreement is reported separately, not silently converted into a native v2 failure.
contamination_stop: Forbidden evidence in an implementation/control-author aperture before its freeze -> CONTAMINATED and no independence claim.
single_decisive_run: One frozen candidate call per fresh ledger once; exclusive run-start receipt; persist decisions before scoring; no pair re-calls; partial execution -> APPARATUS_INVALID, no quiet retry.
no_repair_after_reveal: Preserve candidate and failures; terminate and separately freeze a successor for material repair.
non_claims: Preparation only; no v2 reducer implemented or run.
No natural-language materiality, coverage, support, contradiction or decomposition-safety assessor qualified.
No arbitrary-prose/production grounding or maintained-generation promotion.
No generation/G1-G7/Wave B/TEST/PROSPECTIVE access, CAL, ADR-018 edits, v1 repair/rerun, merge or release.
